#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed Arma Reforger server — generated by provision().
# This server's own files: <ROOT>/installs/armareforger/gamedash-servers/test
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
python3 - "<ROOT>/installs/armareforger/gamedash-servers/test/config.json" "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" <<'SYNC'
import json, sys
p, join, admin = sys.argv[1:4]
d = json.load(open(p, encoding="utf-8-sig"))
def put(keys, val):
    obj = d
    for k in keys[:-1]:
        obj = obj.setdefault(k, {})
    obj[keys[-1]] = val
put(['game', 'password'], join)
put(['game', 'passwordAdmin'], admin)
json.dump(d, open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8"), indent=2)
SYNC
cd "<ROOT>/installs/armareforger/" || exit 1
exec ./ArmaReforgerServer -config "<ROOT>/installs/armareforger/gamedash-servers/test/config.json" -profile "<ROOT>/installs/armareforger/gamedash-servers/test/profile" -maxFPS 60 -nothrow
